001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.output;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput> }.
008 * Creates a standard out output.
009 * <table class="table">
010 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
011 * <tr>
012 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
013 * <th>Type</th>
014 * <th>Required</th>
015 * <th>Default</th>
016 * <th>Description</th>
017 * </tr>
018 * <tr>
019 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_stream }</code></td>
020 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
021 * <td><code>true</code></td>
022 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ConsoleOutputs#DEFAULT_STREAM }</td>
023 * <td>{@link ConsoleStream#CACHED} (default) uses {@link System#out} as it.</td>
024 * </tr>
025 * </table>
026 */
027public final class StdOutOutputBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<StdOutOutputBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput>> {
028
029        /**
030         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
031         * this prefix.
032         */
033        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.output.{name}.";
034        
035        /**
036         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_stream } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ConsoleStream</code> {@link ConsoleStream#CACHED} (default) uses {@link System#out} as it.
037         */
038        static final String PROPERTY_stream = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "stream";
039        
040        private final String propertyPrefix;
041        final String property_stream;
042        
043        private final java.lang.String name;
044        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ConsoleStream stream = io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ConsoleOutputs.DEFAULT_STREAM;
045        
046        /**
047         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput> }.
048         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.output.{name}.</code>. Output name, used for property lookup.
049         */
050        public StdOutOutputBuilder(
051                        java.lang.String name
052                        ) {
053                try {
054                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
055                                        "name", name
056                                );
057                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
058                        this.name = name;
059                        property_stream = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_stream, prefixParameters);
060                }
061                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
062                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
063                }
064        }
065
066
067        
068        /**
069         * Sets <strong>required</strong> stream.
070         * {@link ConsoleStream#CACHED} (default) uses {@link System#out} as it.
071         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ConsoleOutputs#DEFAULT_STREAM }.
072         * @param stream <code>{@value #PROPERTY_stream } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ConsoleStream</code> {@link ConsoleStream#CACHED} (default) uses {@link System#out} as it.
073         * @return this builder.
074         */
075        public StdOutOutputBuilder stream(io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ConsoleStream stream) {
076                this.stream = stream;
077                return this;
078        }
079        
080        /**
081         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput> } from this builder.
082         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput> }.
083         */
084        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProvider<io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput> build() {
085                try {
086                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ConsoleOutputs.stdout(
087                                        this.name
088                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_stream, this.stream)
089                                        );
090                }
091                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
092                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
093                }
094        }
095        
096        @Override
097        public StdOutOutputBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
098                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
099                var _stream = properties.forKey(property_stream).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ConsoleOutputs.parseStream(_v)).or(this.stream).validate(__v);
100                __v.validate();
101                this.stream = _stream.value();
102                return this;
103        }
104        
105        /**
106         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
107         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
108         */
109        @Override
110        public String propertyPrefix() {
111                return this.propertyPrefix;
112        }
113        
114}
